summary: Massimo Group filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting entry into a Strategic Business Outreach and Consulting Agreement with Acorn Management Partners, L.L.C. dated September 28, 2026. The consultant provides investor awareness, broker outreach and professional relations services for a one-year term ending September 27, 2027. Compensation is $15,000 per month in cash; if the engagement continues beyond the initial six months, the consultant receives deferred equity valued at $125,000, capped at 90,000 shares, issued under Rule 4(a)(2). This is a routine service contract, not a special situation.
